title: Puzzle two paths
description: A centred monospace eyebrow and two-line headline over two equal rounded cards: a white one and a deep violet one. Each has a small pill tag (mint or pale violet), a title, a paragraph, a short tick or bullet list, and a footer with a price line on the left and a large button with an arrow on the right. Stacked on phones with the footer centred and the button full width.
notes: the 'brand' card is primary-coloured; under other themes it takes their brand colour
name: puzzle-paths
